LanguageData.LP_Imp.label: infernal imp
LanguageData.LP_Imp.description: A small devil with red skin, little wings and a thin tail, about the size of a cat. Infernal brokers sell them as pets: buying one forms a familiar pact with the buyer. It turns invisible when not fighting, gives its master +10% psychic sensitivity, and every 10 days mutters some "intel" in its master's ear; half of it is true.
LanguageData.LP_Pixie.label: sprite
LanguageData.LP_Pixie.description: A palm-sized fey with a pair of colorful butterfly wings on its back, leaving sparkling dust wherever it goes. Only sold at fey markets; buying one forms a friendship with the buyer. Each day it sprinkles fey dust on its master or a nearby colonist (6 hours: one of move speed +20%, work +20%, mood +10, or invisibility when still); occasionally it plays pranks, tossing things from its master's pack onto the ground.
